description: Every accepted value for create_project / request_variant: goals, platforms, aspect ratios, durations (up to your plan's maximum), qualities (Standard and Studio) with their credits per second (and per second with your code's screens), resolutions (4K policy), languages, voices and music moods. Use it instead of guessing ids.

language.description: List the voices that speak this language (native speakers first, then multilingual voices), filtered by the voice_* fields and paged. Without it: the house and premade voices.

voice_accent.description: With language: one accent (values in voice_filters.accent of a first call).

voice_age.description: With language: only voices of this age.

voice_cursor.description: With language: voices_next_cursor of the previous page.

voice_gender.description: With language: only voices of this gender.

voice_limit.description: With language: voices per page (default 24, at most 100).

voice_search.description: With language: words to find in the name, description, accent or styles (any language, e.g. "warm narrator").

voice_style.description: With language: voices with any of these styles (comma-separated): narrator, advertising, conversational, energetic, calm, warm, authoritative, deep, bright, playful.

title: Allowed settings and prices
